name: Neat
description: Two pages side by side, everything else folded to spines. Send pages, notes or tiles to the far sides with left= and right=; your terminals are left alone.

scripts.name: neat
scripts.about: Two pages side by side, or left= and right= (pages, notes, %tiles) at the far edges; other tiles as spines (terminals and agents stay put), and drawer links wired to the readers.
